purpose: extend ODSP from finite discrete state probabilities to a continuous scalar ecological-state density without altering the frozen v4 empirical endpoints
primary_target: p(a|X) for one real-valued ecological state a
examples: height above ground when genuinely measured or derived with explicit terrain semantics
continuous phenological timing on a non-circular scale

reference_learner.name: weighted linear Gaussian state model
reference_learner.conditional_mean: weighted least-squares intercept plus linear covariate effects
reference_learner.conditional_scale: weighted training residual standard deviation with a declared numerical floor
reference_learner.claim: transparent reference density learner, not the only learner compatible with continuous ODSP

secondary_diagnostics: Gaussian prediction interval coverage when model assumptions are appropriate

external_learner_interface.minimum_requirement: held-out conditional and training-marginal log density at every realized state

obligations: all stable replicates have positive held-out log-density gain
all shifted replicates have negative held-out log-density gain
mean null gain remains near zero
log-density gain is invariant to positive affine transformation of response units
reference 90% Gaussian interval coverage lies between 0.88 and 0.92 under correct specification
